test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A person crosses a road 350 metres wide in 70 seconds. His speed (in km/h) is:
solution:
**Given:**

Width of the road = 350 metres

Time taken to cross the road = 70 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed (in km/h) = (Distance (in meters) / Time (in seconds)) × 18/5

**Calculation:**

Distance = 350 meters

Time = 70 seconds

Speed (in km/h) = (350 / 70) × 18/5

⇒ Speed (in km/h) = 5 × 18/5

⇒ Speed (in km/h) = 18 km/h

**The correct answer is option 1.**
